title: A filter on Category filters Product two relationships away
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Products", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), Category[Category] = "Bikes" ) )

source.quote: The filter on the Category table propagates to the Product table
source.supports: the Category filter propagates to Product

source.quote: Filters will propagate so long as there's a relationship path to follow, which can involve propagation to multiple tables

derivation: Bikes (CategoryKey 1) has subcategories 10 and 11. Products with SubcategoryKey 10 or 11: 100, 101, 102. 3 rows.
